description: This file defines a PHP class `File` in the namespace `Opencart\System\Library\Session`, responsible for managing session data through filesystem storage. It includes methods for reading, writing, destroying session files, and garbage collection of expired sessions.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A class to handle PHP session management by reading, writing, deleting, and cleaning up session files on the filesystem.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the File session handler with registry configuration.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads session data from a file based on session ID.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes session data to a file identified by session ID.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the session file associated with a session ID.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection by deleting expired session files based on configuration.
